note: Two tiers (ADR-0022, amending ADR-0013). `product` is measured on reference hardware (MARXY_PERF_ENV=reference) and never relaxed; `ci` is the envelope and the floor baseline enforced on GitHub-hosted runners (MARXY_PERF_ENV=ci). Amendment 1: the CI statistic is the floor — the minimum of a `runs_n`-launch round with its warm-up discarded — compared against `baseline_ms × tolerance`, where `baseline_ms` is the highest of the `observed_floors_ms` measured on main and `max/min × tolerance` may not exceed 1.20. Milliseconds unless stated. A baseline moves only by an explicit edit in the pull request that costs the time.
